items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) just confirmed it will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas by mid 2027, refunding many deposits as it clears the backlog and redirects capacity toward the Cybercab robotaxi program. Tesla shares now trade at US$379.78, with a 90 day share price return of 16% that contrasts with a year to date share price decline of 13%. items.title: Kai-Fu Lee Questions Soaring AI Valuations
items.summary: AI pioneer Kai-Fu Lee discusses whether trillion-dollar AI valuations can be justified, the risks of circular funding, and the impact of cheaper Chinese and open-source models. The Sinovation Ventures Chairman and CEO and 01.AI CEO also explains why businesses need to reinvent themselves around AI, and why Europe's biggest opportunity may be in AI applications rather than foundation models. Lee appeared on "The Pulse with Francine Lacqua".
